### Prosperity - Today's Insight - August 31, 2024
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-31-2024.html
Passage: Genesis 13:8-9
Points:
- True character and spiritual maturity are tested more by prosperity than by hardship.
- Rapidly growing possessions can strain relationships and easily spark conflict over limited resources.
- Rather than pulling rank as the elder and land-grant heir, Abram chose to act as an unselfish mentor.
- Abram preserved family harmony and honored God by relinquishing his rights and letting Lot choose first.

### The Test of Self-Interest
Author: Oswald Chambers
Site: My Utmost for His Highest
URL: https://utmost.org/modern-classic/the-test-of-self-interest/
Passage: Genesis 13:8-9
Points:
- A genuine walk of faith involves willingly waiving personal rights and allowing God to choose for you.
- Abram declined the natural impulse to claim the best land, choosing obedience over self-preservation.
- Insisting on rights and personal entitlements dulls spiritual insight and hinders spiritual transformation.
- Believers must avoid settling for what merely seems good or advantageous instead of trusting God's direction.
